label: A power for there being no contingent concretum issues in a world where its holder exists
paraphrase: OPEN (P2, initiator presence; analyst reconstruction): whatever has at w a power for there being no contingent concrete being can exercise it so that, at some world accessible from w, there is no contingent concrete being and the holder exists there. With the frame's tenseless world-relative existence, the initiator of a chain exists in the world of that chain. Close to the premise of Pruss's sketch that x cannot start any chain of causes that can lead to actuality's not including x (navigation only, not attributed), with two differences: his principle is universal over chains while this is existential and builds in that the power's outcome is an accessible world; and his direction is mirrored (his holder is in the non-actual world, with a power for the actual world's being actual, and he uses S5 for that world to reach the actual one). Under a tensed reading (absence at the end of a history) a self-annihilating holder falsifies it (controls, Pruss omission 2).
